detail.provenance: CLAUDE.md: 'ldiff is the instructive one: it takes land's base case but its inner succ-row guard is a hybrid' and gives the asymmetry witness 'ldiff 3 5 = 2 against ldiff 5 3 = 4'

witnesses.reason: swapped operands give a DIFFERENT value (4) -- proves ldiff is not commutative, so a commutativity mutation would be vacuous here and is correctly not attempted
m=0 discriminates the absorbing-zero base from lor's pass-through

mutations.description: fuel-exhaustion base returns n instead of the absorbing 0 (copying lor's shape onto an operator that needs land's)
